title: Medium-Term Multi-Resolution Electric Load Forecasting using Economic Data and Foundation Model (abstract page)
note: Preprint, v1 only (2026-09-25), cs.LG, text under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. France, monthly and daily load, forecasts issued 1 to 48 months ahead with a tabular foundation model. 20 years of load, weather and economic data. Says selected economic features improve skill by about 20% over 2015-2025, with MAPE held to about 4% monthly and 5% daily. No code link on the page.

title: Full text of arXiv 2609.31806 (ar5iv rendering, truncated before the appendices)
note: Model is TabICLv2, used in-context without fine-tuning and without lagged load. Target: French national load from RTE, hourly resampled to daily, plus monthly. Weather is ERA5 reanalysis (observed, a hindcast); economic series from INSEE, Eurostat and SDES are also observed values. Data March 2005 to Dec 2025; feature selection on 2005-2015, rolling evaluation Jan 2016 to Dec 2025.

title: Full text of arXiv 2609.31806 (ar5iv rendering, truncated before the appendices)
note: Baselines: a linear model and XGBoost at default settings, each put through the same forward feature selection (10 rolling folds, RMSE; the forecast averages the 10 models), so each ends with its own subset. Daily: economic features improve TabICL by about 20%, steady across lead times. Monthly: the gain shrinks to near zero at 48 months. 95% bootstrap intervals in figures only.

title: Full text of arXiv 2609.31806 (ar5iv rendering, truncated before the appendices)
note: Monthly TabICL with economic data: about 1,000 MW (2% MAPE) at short lead times, under about 2,000 MW (4%) at long ones; XGBoost about 1,400 MW (2.5%) under a year, 2,200 MW (4.3%) beyond. Daily: under about 3,000 MW (5%) at 48 months for both. TabICL best at every resolution. Data on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.22232294); no own code release or pre-registration in the visible text.

title: 20 Years of Load Data for France with matching Weather, Calendar and Economic Covariates
note: Dataset record by E. Lindas (LSCE), v1, CC BY 4.0. French demand, March 2005 to 2025-12-31, daily and monthly, with weather (temperature, humidity, wind), calendar and economic covariates (population, GDP, CPI, industrial production). Files are restricted: login needed, no file list, 0 downloads. No code mentioned, no link to the paper or a repository.

title: soda-inria/tabicl repository
note: TabICL code. Default TabICLv2 regression checkpoint is tabicl-regressor-v2-20260212.ckpt, downloaded from Hugging Face. Offers TabICLRegressor and a zero-shot TabICLForecaster (extra 'forecast'). Device auto-selects CUDA, XPU, MPS or CPU; GPU advised for larger data. Page calls the licence permissive without naming it; no releases listed.
